label: Resolvase DUF5677 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded, resolvase- and DUF5677-associated prokaryotic Schlafen nuclease locus.
observations: Resolvase_DUF5677-associated Schlafen branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Schlafen proteins, individual prokaryotic schlafen genes, non-Resolvase_DUF5677 Schlafen nuclease architectures, general DUF5677-domain or resolvase activities outside a complete anti-phage Schlafen system, and the DefenseFinder Resolvase_DUF5677 source key outside a complete organism-level system.
